message:
I remember during a summer storm, my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die. One minute I was scrolling through weather updates, and the next—black screen. I panicked for a second, but then I remembered the old-school weather radio tucked away in the kitchen drawer. I dug it out, plugged it in, and there it was—steady updates and a sense of calm. 

It made me realize how important it is to have a backup plan for when our fancy gadgets let us down. A little extra prep can go a long way! What’s your go-to tip for staying in the know when technology fails you? ☔
